questions.text: What is the capital of Kenya?
questions.explanation: Nairobi has been the capital of Kenya since independence in 1963 and is its largest city.

questions.text: What is the capital of Nigeria?
questions.explanation: Abuja replaced Lagos as Nigeria's capital in 1991; Lagos remains the country's largest commercial city.

questions.text: What is the capital of Ghana?
questions.explanation: Accra, on Ghana's Atlantic coast, has served as the national capital since independence in 1957.

questions.text: What is the capital of Ethiopia?
questions.explanation: Addis Ababa is Ethiopia's capital and also hosts the headquarters of the African Union.

questions.text: What is the capital of Mozambique?
questions.explanation: Maputo, formerly known as Lourenco Marques, is the capital and largest city of Mozambique.

questions.text: What is the capital of Senegal?
questions.explanation: Dakar, located on the Cap-Vert peninsula, is the capital of Senegal and its main Atlantic port.

questions.text: What is the capital of Zambia?
questions.explanation: Lusaka has been Zambia's capital since 1935, before independence, and remains its largest city.

questions.text: What is the capital of Zimbabwe?
questions.explanation: Harare, formerly called Salisbury, is the capital and largest city of Zimbabwe.

questions.text: What is the capital of Uganda?
questions.explanation: Kampala is Uganda's capital, while nearby Entebbe hosts the country's main international airport.

questions.text: What is the capital of Morocco?
questions.explanation: Rabat is Morocco's political capital, whereas Casablanca is its largest city and commercial hub.

questions.text: What is the capital of Vietnam?
questions.explanation: Hanoi is the capital of Vietnam, while Ho Chi Minh City is its largest and most populous city.

questions.text: What is the capital of Thailand?
questions.explanation: Bangkok has been the capital of Thailand since 1782 and is the country's political and commercial centre.

questions.text: What is the capital of Malaysia?
questions.explanation: Kuala Lumpur is the constitutional capital of Malaysia, while Putrajaya serves as the federal administrative centre.

questions.text: What is the capital of the Philippines?
questions.explanation: Manila is the capital of the Philippines and sits within the wider Metro Manila urban area.

questions.text: What is the capital of Mongolia?
questions.explanation: Ulaanbaatar is Mongolia's capital and by far its largest city, home to nearly half the national population.

questions.text: What is the current capital of Kazakhstan?
questions.explanation: The Kazakh capital was renamed Astana in September 2022, reverting from its earlier name, Nur-Sultan.

questions.text: What is the capital of Uzbekistan?
questions.explanation: Tashkent is the capital of Uzbekistan, while Samarkand and Bukhara are historic Silk Road cities in the country.

questions.text: What is the capital of Jordan?
questions.explanation: Amman is the capital and largest city of the Hashemite Kingdom of Jordan.

questions.text: What is the capital of Iraq?
questions.explanation: Baghdad, on the Tigris River, is the capital of Iraq and one of the historic centres of the Islamic world.

questions.text: What is the capital of Nepal?
questions.explanation: Kathmandu is the capital of Nepal, situated in the Kathmandu Valley in the country's hill region.

questions.text: What is the capital of Portugal?
questions.explanation: Lisbon, on the Atlantic coast, has been the capital of Portugal since the mid-13th century.

questions.text: What is the capital of Greece?
questions.explanation: Athens is the capital of Greece and one of the oldest continuously inhabited cities in the world.

questions.text: What is the capital of Austria?
questions.explanation: Vienna is Austria's capital and its largest city, long a centre of European music and diplomacy.

questions.text: What is the capital of Poland?
questions.explanation: Warsaw has been the capital of Poland since 1596 and remains the country's largest city today.

questions.text: What is the capital of Hungary?
questions.explanation: Budapest, formed by the union of Buda and Pest on the Danube, is the capital of Hungary.

questions.text: What is the capital of Norway?
questions.explanation: Oslo is the capital of Norway and its largest city, located at the head of the Oslofjord.

questions.text: What is the capital of Finland?
questions.explanation: Helsinki, on the Gulf of Finland, is the capital and largest city of Finland.

questions.text: What is the capital of Croatia?
questions.explanation: Zagreb, in the country's continental north, is the capital and largest city of Croatia.

questions.text: What is the capital of Canada?
questions.explanation: Ottawa is Canada's capital, chosen by Queen Victoria in 1857; Toronto is the country's largest city.

questions.text: What is the capital of Brazil?
questions.explanation: Brasilia, a purpose-built city, became Brazil's capital in 1960, replacing Rio de Janeiro.

questions.text: What is the capital of Argentina?
questions.explanation: Buenos Aires, on the Rio de la Plata, is the capital and largest city of Argentina.

questions.text: What is the capital of Peru?
questions.explanation: Lima, founded by Spanish conquistadors in 1535, is the capital and largest city of Peru.

questions.text: What is the capital of Colombia?
questions.explanation: Bogota, high in the Andes, is the capital and largest city of Colombia.

questions.text: What is the capital of Chile?
questions.explanation: Santiago is the capital of Chile, while Valparaiso serves as the seat of the national congress.

questions.text: What is the capital of Cuba?
questions.explanation: Havana is the capital of Cuba and its largest city and principal port.

questions.text: What is the capital of Australia?
questions.explanation: Canberra was purpose-built as a compromise capital between Sydney and Melbourne and has served as Australia's capital since 1927.

questions.text: What is the capital of New Zealand?
questions.explanation: Wellington has been New Zealand's capital since 1865, while Auckland is the country's largest city.

questions.text: What is the capital of Fiji?
questions.explanation: Suva, on the island of Viti Levu, is the capital and largest city of Fiji.

questions.text: What is the capital of Jamaica?
questions.explanation: Kingston has been the capital of Jamaica since 1872 and is the largest English-speaking city in the Caribbean.

questions.text: What is the capital of Papua New Guinea?
questions.explanation: Port Moresby, on the southern coast, is the capital and largest city of Papua New Guinea.

questions.text: Which currency is used in Japan?
questions.explanation: The yen has been Japan's official currency since 1871.

questions.text: Which currency is used in South Korea?
questions.explanation: The South Korean won is the official currency of the Republic of Korea.

questions.text: Which currency is used in China?
questions.explanation: China's official currency is the renminbi, whose basic unit is the yuan.

questions.text: Which currency is used in Thailand?
questions.explanation: The baht has been Thailand's official currency for centuries and remains in use today.

questions.text: Which currency is used in Vietnam?
questions.explanation: The dong is the official currency of Vietnam, issued by the State Bank of Vietnam.

questions.text: Which currency is used in Indonesia?
questions.explanation: The rupiah is Indonesia's official currency, issued by Bank Indonesia.

questions.text: Which currency is used in India?
questions.explanation: The Indian rupee is the official currency of the Republic of India.

questions.text: Which currency is used in Turkey?
questions.explanation: The Turkish lira is the official currency of Turkey, issued by the Central Bank of the Republic of Turkey.

questions.text: Which currency is used in Egypt?
questions.explanation: The Egyptian pound has been the country's official currency since the early 20th century.

questions.text: Which currency is used in Saudi Arabia?
questions.explanation: The Saudi riyal is the official currency of the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia.

questions.text: Which currency is used in Israel?
questions.explanation: The New Israeli Shekel is the official currency of Israel.

questions.text: Which currency is used in Iran?
questions.explanation: The Iranian rial is the official currency of Iran, issued by the Central Bank of Iran.

questions.text: Which currency is used in Russia?
questions.explanation: The ruble has been the currency of Russia for centuries and is issued by the Bank of Russia.

questions.text: Which currency is used in Poland?
questions.explanation: The zloty is Poland's official currency; Poland has not adopted the euro despite being an EU member.

questions.text: Which currency is used in Sweden?
questions.explanation: The Swedish krona is Sweden's official currency; like Poland, Sweden has kept its own currency outside the eurozone.

questions.text: Which currency is used in Switzerland?
questions.explanation: The Swiss franc is the official currency of Switzerland and is also used in Liechtenstein.

questions.text: Which currency is used in South Africa?
questions.explanation: The rand has been South Africa's official currency since 1961.

questions.text: Which currency is used in Nigeria?
questions.explanation: The naira is Nigeria's official currency, introduced in 1973.

questions.text: Which currency is used in Kenya?
questions.explanation: The Kenyan shilling is the official currency of Kenya, issued by the Central Bank of Kenya.

questions.text: Which currency is used in Ghana?
questions.explanation: The cedi is Ghana's official currency, first introduced in 1965.

questions.text: Which currency is used in Ethiopia?
questions.explanation: The birr is the official currency of Ethiopia, issued by the National Bank of Ethiopia.

questions.text: Which currency is used in Mexico?
questions.explanation: The Mexican peso is the official currency of Mexico.

questions.text: Which currency is used in Brazil?
questions.explanation: The Brazilian real has been the country's official currency since 1994.

questions.text: Which currency is used in Argentina?
questions.explanation: The Argentine peso is the official currency of Argentina.

questions.text: Which currency is used in Canada?
questions.explanation: The Canadian dollar is Canada's official currency, distinct from the US dollar despite the shared name.

questions.text: Which currency does Ecuador officially use?
questions.explanation: Ecuador abandoned its own currency, the sucre, and adopted the US dollar as legal tender in 2000.

questions.text: What is the name of Panama's official currency, which is pegged 1:1 to the US dollar?
questions.explanation: The balboa is Panama's official currency; it circulates alongside, and is fixed at par with, the US dollar.

questions.text: Which currency is used in Cote d'Ivoire (Ivory Coast)?
questions.explanation: Cote d'Ivoire uses the West African CFA franc, a shared currency used by several former French West African colonies.

questions.text: Which currency is used in Norway?
questions.explanation: The Norwegian krone is Norway's official currency; Norway is not a member of the European Union.

questions.text: Which currency is used in Morocco?
questions.explanation: The Moroccan dirham is the official currency of Morocco.

questions.text: What is the official language of Brazil?
questions.explanation: Portuguese is Brazil's official language, a legacy of Portuguese colonial rule; Brazil is the largest Portuguese-speaking country in the world.

questions.text: What is the most widely spoken language in Mexico?
questions.explanation: Spanish is the dominant language of Mexico, spoken by the vast majority of its population, alongside dozens of indigenous languages.

questions.text: What is the official language of Egypt?
questions.explanation: Arabic is the official language of Egypt, spoken by the great majority of its population.

questions.text: What is the official language of Iran?
questions.explanation: Persian, also called Farsi, is the official language of Iran.

questions.text: What is the official language of Turkey?
questions.explanation: Turkish is the official language of Turkey and is written in the Latin alphabet since a 1928 reform.

questions.text: What is the official language of Indonesia?
questions.explanation: Indonesian (Bahasa Indonesia), a standardised form of Malay, is Indonesia's official national language.

questions.text: What is the official language of Mongolia?
questions.explanation: Mongolian is the official language of Mongolia and is written using the Cyrillic script domestically.

questions.text: What is the official language of Vietnam?
questions.explanation: Vietnamese is the official language of Vietnam and is written in a Latin-based script.

questions.text: Which language serves as the working language of Ethiopia's federal government?
questions.explanation: Amharic is the working language of Ethiopia's federal government, though the country recognises many regional languages.

questions.text: What is the official language of Israel?
questions.explanation: Hebrew is the official language of Israel under the country's 2018 Basic Law; Arabic holds a special status.

questions.text: On which continent is Egypt located?
questions.explanation: Egypt lies mainly in northeastern Africa, though the Sinai Peninsula extends into Asia.

questions.text: Which continent is Peru located on?
questions.explanation: Peru lies on the western coast of South America, bordering the Pacific Ocean.

questions.text: Which continent is Mongolia located on?
questions.explanation: Mongolia is a landlocked country in East Asia, situated between Russia and China.

questions.text: Which continent is Fiji part of?
questions.explanation: Fiji is an island nation in the South Pacific and is part of Oceania.

questions.text: Which continent is Iceland part of?
questions.explanation: Iceland is politically and culturally part of Europe, despite sitting on the Mid-Atlantic Ridge.

questions.text: Which continent is Sri Lanka located on?
questions.explanation: Sri Lanka is an island nation off the southeastern coast of India, part of South Asia.

questions.text: Which continent is Bolivia located on?
questions.explanation: Bolivia is a landlocked country in central South America.

questions.text: Which continent is Madagascar part of?
questions.explanation: Madagascar is a large island nation off the southeastern coast of Africa.

questions.text: Which continent is Tunisia located on?
questions.explanation: Tunisia lies on the northern coast of Africa, along the Mediterranean Sea.

questions.text: Which continent is Costa Rica part of?
questions.explanation: Costa Rica is in Central America, which is geographically part of the North American continent.
